title: Sort the Shipment
description: Figure out how to order the shipment, then build a machine that does the repetitive work for you.

interactiveChallenge.playerDescription:
The packages are out of order.
Can you figure out how to move them into the correct order?
interactiveChallenge.conceptExplanation:
Bubble Sort repeatedly compares neighboring values.
When two values are in the wrong order, they are swapped.
Each pass moves the largest remaining value toward the end.
interactiveChallenge.machineRevealBody:
You just performed the process yourself.
Now let's make the machine do the repetitive work.

practiceChallenge.playerDescription: You know how this works. Now sort the shipment yourself.

masteryChallenge.playerDescription: Show that you can do it on a new shipment.

optimalCreator.historicalContext: Invented while working on the EDVAC computer system.
optimalCreator.kidFriendlyStory: John was a brilliant scientist who realized cleaning a mess is easier in small piles!

tutorialSteps.message: 1. Tap Bubble Sort in Available Machines to place it on the factory floor.
2. Drag from Input Shipment's OUT port into Bubble Sort's IN port.
3. Connect Bubble Sort's OUT port to the Output IN port.
4. Press Execute Factory to test your design.
Your factory has finished. You can watch the execution to understand how Bubble Sort processed the shipment — or skip if you just want the result.
